relations.justification_span: The primary symptom was chronic pruritus
Previous medication trials provided only minimal benefit
She initially responded well to omalizumab but became refractory after 1 week of treatment
Examination revealed edematous, superficial wheals and plaques on the arms, back, and thighs, along with dermatographism
Skin biopsies revealed dermal edema with sparse chronic inflammation and dilated blood vessels within the superficial dermis
Skin-prick allergy testing was negative, but skin patch testing showed positive results for methylisothiazolinones
